title: io.loams.dev.usage.mcp.call.v1
description: The `data` of a `io.loams.dev.usage.mcp.call.v1` usage event: An MCP tool call through the gateway (§57 §12.3). Producer: gateway mcp module. Design §63 §6.3. Measured values are integers in the unit named; dimensions are strings. New optional fields may be added within v1.
